note: The tracker (issues with the label `track` on Bobikobi/GAME) is the source of the plan; this file is its view for contributors: one line per stream that has an open tracker issue, with the branches those issues work on. The first `plan` entry of each stream names its tracker issues. A finished stream is removed; one that waits for the owner's word says `parked`. Edited only when a stream starts, ends or changes hands; the live picture (pull requests, CI, conflicts, order) is computed by `pnpm streams`, never written here. owner names the role of the session that holds the stream; the integration session assigns it (docs/team/PARALLEL.md).
